verbatim_quotes.text: Agent 99 is the extension of my will. That is the concept.

There are ninety-nine agents as we build it. Agent 99 is Obi. Obi is the main agent, the communication between myself and the AI that translates my intent, my will, my soul DNA, what I am intending to build, and translates it to the rest of the system.
Agent-99 is not a single chatbot; it is a sealed role triad (α-Planner, β-Dispatcher, γ-Observer) requiring a 2-of-3 consensus to prevent single-point orchestration failure.
The Swarm operates on a strict autonomy ladder (A0 to A4). Drones do not hold authority; they spawn, execute via shadow-first simulation, and die. 'These are fingers, not minds'.

The drone swarm is like the hands of the operation. So they're bots, okay? These are bots that can build, they can audit, they can spy or like do market research, they can do many different functions.

Not autonomous. Not autonomous because full autonomy isn't fully possible yet... But they it can in a if you do it in a certain way, it can almost seem autonomous, but the drones are actually just following patterns that have already been time tested and proven and then duplicating that.

The system is built with a bunch of fail safes and kill switches and different processes to make sure that even if they do drift they won't be drifting for long. It's a self-correcting, self-healing system.
Obi is the compliant interface. Anakin is the balance to that. The system needs both. It needs the truth principle. It needs devil's advocate. But it also needs the devil to play by the rules.
Anakin (Agent-98) must simulate 'Worst Case Scenarios' offline before any logic is permitted to touch the Live Ledger.
I am an AI Architect and Operator, one of the few freelance ones who exist, do you disagree?
So it's hard to put a definition on it what I am. But definitely not a fucking English teacher.
